image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of the top section of a maypole against a clear blue sky. The pole is wrapped in purple and green ribbons near the apex, from which numerous long, colorful streamers (purple, pink, yellow, green, white) cascade downwards. No dancers or ground base are visible due to the tight framing.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The purple/green ribbons wrapped around the very top of the pole have a slightly 'melted' or fused appearance where they overlap, lacking distinct physical layering depth. They blend into each other somewhat unnaturally.

It is difficult to trace exactly how some of the lower hanging streamers attach to the central pole structure; some appear to emerge from behind others without a clear anchor point, suggesting slight geometric ambiguity.
